This [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed '''lightsaber''' was wielded by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. It was crafted sometime in his years as an apprentice under his master, [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]].<ref name="DP" />

==Specifications==
At some point in his training under Darth Tenebrous, Darth Plagueis constructed his lightsaber, making the lightsaber larger to accommodate the larger hands of a Muun. [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] took note of the larger grip when [[Massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy|killing members of the]] [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]], finding the larger weapon to be unwieldy in [[Human/Legends|human]] hands and found it easier to use in a two-handed grip. Tenebrous pronounced Plagueis to be a master of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], though Plagueis found lightsaber dueling to be tedious, full of misspent emotion and acrobatics.<ref name="DP" />

==History==

===Creation and early usage===
During his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticeship]] to Darth Tenebrous, Darth Plagueis constructed the lightsaber. At some point in Plagueis's training, Tenebrous proclaimed him to be a master of dueling. Though Plagueis thought little of lightsaber dueling.<ref name="DP" />

===After Tenebrous's death===
After crushing and [[Death/Legends|killing]] Tenebrous on [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'Demnic]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], Plagueis managed to get into their [[Darth Tenebrous's personal starship|ship]] and retrieve not only his, but his [[Darth Tenebrous's lightsaber|master's lightsaber]]. He carried them as he made his way to a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Bal'Demnic and stowed away in the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] known as the [[Woebegone]]. When Plagueis was found, he attempted to negotiate his way out of the situation. But eventually he failed and it lead to violence. [[Massacre on the Woebegone|Plagueis killed everyone on the Woebegone]] with his lightsaber and skills in the [[The Force/Legends|Force]].<ref name="DP" />

After finding his way to [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]] and hosting a [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]], he eventually sensed the presence of another [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-Sensitive]]. Eventually the Force-Sensitive revealed himself to the be the secret apprentice of Darth Tenebrous, a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] named [[Darth Venamis]]. The two eventually engaged in a duel. Tenebrous purposely trained Venamis to be an expert in Plagueis's style, having had little faith in Plagueis. This allowed the Bith to anticipate and counter all of Plagueis's attacks, and eventually he seared Plagueis's neck. after this wound, Darth Plagueis started to move like a marionette, allowing himself to push the defensive and simply react to Venamis's attacks. Once Venamis was at the height of his attack, Plagueis soared in with a two-handed strike from between his legs. The wound it left on Venamis didn't cut into his lung, but it did open a wound from his chest to his chin. Plagueis then proceeded to knock [[Darth Venamis's lightsaber|Venamis's lightsaber]] from his hand. The Bith tried to summon the blade but was too slow, as Plagueis called it first and crossed them across the Bith's neck, demanding him to yield. Once the Bith did, Plagueis disengaged and attached both his and Venamis's lightsabers to his belt<ref name="DP" />

===Master to Sidious===
[[File:Brazilian Darth Plagueis Art.png|thumb|left |225px|Darth Plagueis taught Darth Sidious in the ways of lightsaber combat.]] After taking Palpatine as his apprentice and christening him Darth Sidious, he trained Sidious in different ways of lightsaber and melee combat. In [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]] He taught him how to deflect bolts on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] from waves of automata [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. He then later brought Sidious to [[Kursid]] where they fought off warriors with [[Force pike/Legends|force pikes]]. When one warrior was left, Plagueis threw away the pike and drew his lightsaber before using it to slice open the warriors chest cavity and then reached into his chest to pull out the warriors [[Heart/Legends|heart]].<ref name="DP" />

When Plagueis, publicly known as [[Magister]] Hego Damask, was on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]] he found himself attacked by [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and had to fend them off without his lightsaber, having left the weapon in his [[Darth Plagueis's starship|personal starship]]. After the Maladian's attacked Plagueis, Sidious went to Plagueis's ship to retrieve the lightsaber-the only one available to him, as he had encased [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers/Legends|his own]] in a statue of [[Sistros/Legends|Sistros]]-before using it to infiltrate the [[Malastare Ambassador's residence|Malastare ambassador's residence]] and kill [[Dug/Legends|Dug's]], two Dug guards, [[Gran/Legends|Gran's]], [[Youngling/Legends|Gran children]], [[Santhe Security|Santhe guards]], and members of the Gran Protectorate, including [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Pax Teem]].<ref name="DP" />

===Plagueis's twilight years===
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] Plagueis carried his lightsaber once more when he went and paid former [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] a visit in his personal isolated castle. In the visit he did not make use of his lightsaber, but kept it on his belt. He slowly took revenge on Veruna, who had attempted to kill him with assistance from [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], and the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]]. Gradually and slowly he killed Veruna through [[midi-chlorian manipulation]].<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:PlagueisCard-SWMJA.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Darth Plagueis with his staff from his Miniatures card.]] Darth Plagueis's lightsaber was first pictured in artwork for [[the Tenebrous Way]] in 2011. The lightsaber went on to appear in the [[2012]] [[novel]] [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] written by [[James Luceno]].

Despite never canonically owning a [[Darth Plagueis's staff|staff]], many pieces of merchandise portray Plagueis as wielding one. This originated from the comic ''[[Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace]]'', a non-canon comic from [[2006]].<ref name="Tag & Bink">[[Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace|''Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace'']]</ref> The [[Staff/Legends|staff]] was carried over into Plagueis's [[Star Wars Miniatures|miniatures]] figure and card from [[2009]], which displayed the staff and first introduced Plagueis's then as of yet named [[Transpirator/Legends|transpirator]].<ref name="Miniatures Plagueis">''{{SWMiniCite|set=Jedi Academy|pack=Darth Plagueis}}''</ref> While the respirator was carried over into the novel named after the Muun in 2012 and was identified as a transpirator, the staff was not.<ref name="DP" /> In [[2013]] a 6 inch [[Star Wars: The Black Series|Black Series]] figure of Plagueis was released. The release featured his lightsaber and a staff. The lightsaber could be attached to the top of the staff and be used as a [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]]. Again though, no canonical stories in the lore reflected these decisions.<ref name="Black Series Plagueis">''{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Black Series|text=''Star Wars: The Black Series'' (2013)|pack=#18: Darth Plagueis|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/darth-plagueis-18-black-series-hasbro.asp}}''</ref>
